text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross hasn't turned up for training yet. Just as I wonder whether she's going to show up at all…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I figured I should get some grub in before exercisin', but I accidentally got too much.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: My stomach was burstin' by the time I was halfway done, but there's no way I was gonna leave good food uneaten.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: In the end, I got all of it down, but it took me a while… I'm really sorry, so I hope ya aren't too miffed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I know how difficult Tamamo Cross finds it to eat large portions of food, and she seems genuinely sorry, so I let her off the hook with a light warning.
